path.description: This category's address on the old site, kept where the permalink pattern would build another (a parent that did not move, a slug the store spells differently). Used only while its last part is this category's slug: change the slug and the category moves to the pattern's address, the old one redirecting there. Clearing it moves the category too; add a redirect for the old address if it is still linked.
path.label: Kept address
